description: Hand-written questions for testing retrieval, each with the files that answer it. Written by reading the code before any retrieval ran on these repos. Questions are phrased the way a newcomer would ask them, mostly without the code's own names, so keyword search gets no free ride. A question counts as found when any expected file appears in the top results.
